image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a horse's head and neck. The horse has a reddish-brown (chestnut/sorrel) coat with a prominent white blaze running down its face. It is wearing a white saddle pad or blanket on its back. The background consists of blurred green foliage, indicating an outdoor setting.

The neck exhibits a natural curve and appears robust, consistent with a healthy horse.

The white blaze violates strict uniformity, but fits the 'no black points' criteria. I will mark as present because 'sorrel' allows for white markings, but note the deviation from 'uniform'.
